fieldValues.title: The handbook is a projection of records, kept true by a weekly watcher
fieldValues.move: The handbook becomes an SRS repository in the clerk; the markdown is its rendered Composition with a drift check in CI. A narrative part tells the whole process with diagrams; each stage records theory, practice, gaps and tests. A weekly Watcher routine re-reads code, data and boards, updates the records and opens one PR, and files what it cannot fix as issues.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Briefs and docs outside the handbook still restate rules (SP-65); the watcher only reports those. Facts are checked by an agent reading, not by code, except the drift between records and markdown.
fieldValues.falsifier: After four weekly runs, a handbook claim contradicted by code or data is found by someone other than the watcher, or a new participant still has to ask in a session how work is driven.
fieldValues.return_when: After the fourth weekly run, or when the watcher's PR goes unmerged two weeks running.
